* WHAT...Blizzard conditions possible. Total snow accumulations of 1
- 3 inches possible. Winds could gust as high as 65 mph, reducing
visibility to one quarter mile or less.

* WHERE...Kuskokwim Delta Coast, Nunivak Island, Good News Bay and
Platinum

* WHEN...From Tuesday afternoon through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. Very strong winds could
cause extensive damage to power lines. Visibilities reduced to one
quarter mile or less due to blowing snow.

Coast on Tuesday, bringing a long duration of gusty southerly
winds. Temperatures are expected to warm Wednesday morning,
allowing for a transition to mixed precipitation.

potential for falling and/or blowing snow with strong winds and
extremely poor visibilities. This can lead to whiteout conditions and
make travel very hazardous.
